message:
Add a zero-copy implementation of ConvertGraphDefToGraph().

Currently, when initializing the execution state for a Session, we build a `GraphDef` protocol buffer, then convert it to a pointer-based `Graph*`. The existing converter takes a `const GraphDef&`, which means that peak memory utilization is approximately 2x the size of the original graph. This change adds an implementation of the converter that takes a `GraphDef&&`, and moves the contained `NodeDef`s all the way into the resulting `Graph*`, which avoids keeping two copies of any `NodeDef` in memory at once.
